newsitem.title: GERMANY: Yeltsin lands in Germany for meeting with Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin lands in Germany for meeting with Kohl.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin landed in Germany on Wednesday at the start of a two-day visit during which he was to meet Chancellor Helmut Kohl and receive a "Man of the Year" award from German media.

Yeltsin's aircraft touched down at Stuttgart airport in southwestern Germany. He was travelling by road to the spa town of Baden-Baden, where the formal part of the visit was to take place on Thursday.

The talks between the two leaders, their second meeting in three months, were likely to focus on intensive efforts to negotiate a charter defining Russia's relationship with the expanding NATO defence alliance.

Also certain to be discussed was the most awkward issue in relations between Russia and its closest friend in the West -- the fate of priceless art treasures taken from Germany by the Red Army at the end of World War Two.
